D015_l001.question: A 59-year-old married male farmer presents with a 14-month history of significant mood disturbance and associated symptoms. He reports pervasive feelings of inner emptiness and worthlessness. Sleep disturbance is prominent, characterized by recurrent distressing nightmares. The patient exhibits psychomotor agitation, including an inability to sit still and frequent pacing. He also describes intermittent, intrusive suicidal impulses, manifesting as urges to jump from heights or run into traffic, though without a formulated plan. Concurrently, he experiences somatic delusions, expressing a baseless conviction of a serious abnormality with his internal organs. He also reports gustatory hallucinations, perceiving tastes that are not objectively present. These delusional and hallucinatory experiences are strictly confined to the episodes of mood disturbance. The patient's presentation has resulted in significant functional impairment.
D015_l001.options:
A. Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type)
    B. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
    C. Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
    D. Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
D015_l001.answer: B. Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
